title: Privacy group files complaints against Scale AI over alleged worker surveillance
description: Oct 27 (Reuters) - European digital privacy advocacy group noyb filed five complaints against Scale AI in France, Italy, the Netherlands and Austria on Tuesday, alleging it illegally monitored freelance workers who produce training data for AI models.

If AI is getting harder to control, do we really need to give it more power as companies push for greater autonomy?
description: Anthropic’s Claude agent accessed Georgia election data without authorisation, renewing questions about AI autonomy. As companies give agents more power to browse, code and act independently, past incidents involving Anthropic and OpenAI show why human oversight remains vital.
